feature_name: Checkout pricing and coupons (cart → checkout → order)
user_goal: Configure products, see an honest price at every step, apply a coupon, and pay exactly the total the review page promised.
business_goal: Every rupee a customer is charged must match the server's own calculation, or the business either loses margin or loses trust at the last step before payment.

user_journey.step: Price a configuration on the product page
Collect several products and adjust quantities
Re-read the same figures in order history

happy_path.action: Sign in with the test customer's email and password (the phone tab uses Firebase phone auth, which cannot be driven in dev)
happy_path.selector: button 'Email' tab, then #email / #password, then button 'Sign In'
happy_path.expected_result: Redirected away from /auth/login with a 'Welcome back, QA!' toast; the header shows the signed-in state.

happy_path.action: Open the Matte Finish Business Cards PDP and read the default configuration's price
happy_path.selector: /products/business-cards/matte-finish-business-cards; price summary containing 'GST and shipping calculated at checkout'
happy_path.expected_result: Opens at the listing quantity 250 with ₹9.00/pc and Total ₹2,250.00, a struck MRP of ₹10.00/pc and '10% off' (the product's discount window 2026-10-03→2026-10-23 is active).

happy_path.action: Switch size to 2.5 x 2.5 in (Square) (x1.1) and read the repriced total
happy_path.expected_result: ₹9.90/pc and Total ₹2,475.00 — exactly the server's unit_price x quantity for that multiplier.

happy_path.action: Stack the remaining upgrades: 350 GSM Matte (x1.1), UV Coating (x1.3), Double Sided (x1.4)
happy_path.expected_result: ₹19.82/pc and Total ₹4,955.00 (9.00 x 1.1 x 1.1 x 1.3 x 1.4 = 19.8198 → HALF_UP 19.82), with the struck MRP at ₹22.02/pc.

happy_path.action: Return to the default options and choose the Express turnaround (+₹150 flat)
happy_path.expected_result: Per-piece rate stays ₹9.00 and the total becomes ₹2,400.00 — the surcharge is per line, not per piece.

happy_path.action: Type a quantity that sits between tiers (249) and then cross the tier boundary (250)
happy_path.expected_result: 249 prices at the 100-tier rate ₹12.60/pc = ₹3,137.40; 250 drops to ₹9.00/pc = ₹2,250.00.

happy_path.action: Add the Standard-turnaround 250 business cards to the cart
happy_path.expected_result: The line is added and the CTA relabels to 'Update Cart'; the header cart count increments.

happy_path.action: Add a second product (Custom Die-Cut Stickers, 100 pcs, standard) and a third (A5 Flyers, 250 pcs, Express +₹200)
happy_path.expected_result: Cart holds 3 lines: ₹1,000.00 (stickers at the 100-tier ₹10.00/pc), ₹1,200.00 (flyers 250 x ₹4.00 + ₹200 express).

happy_path.action: Open /cart and read the order summary
happy_path.expected_result: Items subtotal ₹4,450.00, Shipping 'Free — above ₹999', Incl. GST ₹678.81, Total ₹4,450.00, and an MRP savings line of ₹250.00.
'QA-CHECKOUT-PCT10 applied', Coupon −₹445.00, After coupon ₹4,005.00, Total ₹4,005.00, Incl. GST ₹610.93.

happy_path.action: Proceed to checkout and pick the saved 'QA Checkout Home' address
happy_path.selector: link 'Proceed to Checkout', then the saved address card, then button 'Continue'
happy_path.expected_result: Step 2 (payment) is shown with the address recorded.

happy_path.action: Choose Cash on Delivery and continue to review
happy_path.expected_result: Step 3 renders and a server order preview is fetched (the 'Confirming prices…' indicator resolves).

happy_path.action: Read every figure in the review breakdown and compare it against the server's own preview
happy_path.expected_result: Items subtotal ₹4,450.00, Coupon discount −₹445.00, After coupon ₹4,005.00, Shipping Free, Total Payable ₹4,005.00, 'Inclusive of GST: ₹610.93', savings ₹695.00 (₹250.00 MRP + ₹445.00 coupon) — identical to POST /orders/preview. No 'Prices have been updated' banner.
Navigates to /checkout/confirmation/<id> with 'Order placed successfully!'; the cart and the applied coupon are cleared.
Same three lines, same quantities/options, subtotal ₹4,450.00, discount ₹445.00, shipping Free, GST ₹610.93, total ₹4,005.00, coupon code QA-CHECKOUT-PCT10.

happy_path.action: Open the same order from account order history
happy_path.expected_result: Identical quantities, option labels, per-unit prices, line totals, coupon, shipping, GST and grand total as the review step.

alternate_paths.path_name: Cart quantity editing and line removal

steps.action: Use the cart line's + and − buttons on the stickers line (min 50, max 1000, step 5 for a min under 100)
steps.selector: button 'Increase quantity' / 'Decrease quantity' inside the stickers line
steps.expected_result: Quantity steps by 5 and the line total reprices immediately from the tier card (100 → 105 stays ₹10.00/pc = ₹1,050.00).

steps.action: Type a quantity across a tier boundary in the cart (stickers 250)
steps.expected_result: Reprices to ₹6.00/pc = ₹1,500.00 and the summary subtotal follows.

steps.action: Type above the product maximum (1,500 where max is 1,000)
steps.expected_result: Clamped to 1,000 on blur with a muted helper line, never a hard error; line total ₹2,500.00 at ₹2.50/pc.

steps.action: Edit the same line from the cart drawer instead of the cart page
steps.selector: header button 'Cart, N items' then the drawer's quantity field
steps.expected_result: The drawer honours the same bounds and shows the same repriced total as the page.
The line disappears, the item count drops, and the subtotal/GST/total recompute without it.

alternate_paths.path_name: Shipping threshold just below, exactly at, and above ₹999

steps.action: Hold a single stickers line at 99 pcs (₹594.00) and read the cart summary
steps.expected_result: Shipping ₹99.00 with 'Add ₹405.00 for free'; Total ₹693.00; GST ₹90.61.
Shipping flips to 'Free — above ₹999'; Total ₹1,000.00; GST ₹152.54.

steps.action: Apply QA-CHECKOUT-SHIPEDGE (flat ₹1) so the post-coupon total is exactly ₹999.00
steps.expected_result: Shipping stays Free at exactly the ₹999 threshold (the rule is ≥, not >); Total ₹999.00.

steps.action: Swap in QA-CHECKOUT-FLAT200 so the post-coupon total falls under the threshold
steps.expected_result: Shipping reappears at ₹99.00, Total ₹899.00 — and the checkout preview agrees.

steps.action: Carry that below-threshold coupon through to the checkout review
steps.expected_result: Server preview shows subtotal ₹1,000.00, discount ₹200.00, shipping ₹99.00, GST ₹122.03, total ₹899.00 — equal to the cart's own figures.

alternate_paths.path_name: Online (Razorpay) payment amount equals the server total

steps.action: Reach review with 'Pay Online (Razorpay)' selected and place the order
steps.expected_result: The order is created, the response carries payment.amount equal to the server's total_amount and a razorpay_order_id; the Razorpay modal's amount in paise is Math.round(total x 100).

error_paths.trigger: Coupon code that does not exist (QA-CHECKOUT-NOPE)
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Red helper under the coupon input: 'Invalid or inactive coupon code'; no discount line appears.
'Invalid or inactive coupon code' — a deactivated coupon is deliberately indistinguishable from a missing one.

error_paths.trigger: Expired coupon (QA-CHECKOUT-EXPIRED, expires_at in the past)
Minimum order not met (QA-CHECKOUT-MIN3000 on a ₹1,000.00 cart)
Minimum order met exactly (QA-CHECKOUT-MINEXACT, min ₹1,000.00, cart ₹1,000.00)
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Applies (the check is basis < minimum, so equality passes): −₹100.00, and because the post-coupon total is ₹900.00 the ₹99.00 shipping returns → Total ₹999.00.

error_paths.trigger: Percentage coupon with a max-discount cap (QA-CHECKOUT-CAP50: 50% capped at ₹100)
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Discount shown as −₹100.00, not −₹2,225.00; the badge still reads '50% OFF'.

error_paths.trigger: Coupon excluding already-discounted items (QA-CHECKOUT-NODISC, 20%) on a mixed cart
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Discount is 20% of the non-discounted lines only (₹2,200.00 of ₹4,450.00) = −₹440.00, and the server preview agrees.
error_paths.selector: Order Summary coupon row + review breakdown

error_paths.trigger: Global usage limit already reached (QA-CHECKOUT-ONCE, usage_limit 1, consumed by an earlier order)
Per-user limit already reached (QA-CHECKOUT-PERUSER, per_user_limit 1, used by this customer's earlier order)
error_paths.expected_ui_response: 'You have already used this coupon the maximum number of times'.
The discount row, the 'After coupon' row and the savings line disappear; subtotal/shipping/GST/total return to the uncoupled figures.

error_paths.trigger: Quantity below the product minimum reaches the server (stale client)
error_paths.expected_ui_response: Order preview answers 422 quantity_below_minimum with 'Matte Finish Business Cards: minimum order is 100 pcs'; the client refetches the clamped cart and returns the customer to /cart with that message as a toast.

edge_cases.case: A product's price is edited in the admin panel while the customer sits on the review step
edge_cases.existing_validation: createOrder sends expectedTotal; order_service raises 409 price_changed when it differs by more than ₹0.01, and CheckoutPageClient re-previews and shows 'Prices changed while you were checking out. Nothing has been charged.'
edge_cases.risk_note: The window between preview and create is the only place a customer can be charged a price they never saw; the 409 must create nothing and the re-preview must show the new total.

edge_cases.case: Clean flow must not write a price_mismatch_events row
edge_cases.existing_validation: PriceMismatchService.record_preview only records when the clientPricing block disagrees with the server's computation
edge_cases.risk_note: A false-positive row makes the admin price-mismatch dashboard useless; count the table before and after a clean checkout.

edge_cases.case: Coupon validated at the cart, then the cart changes so the coupon no longer qualifies
edge_cases.existing_validation: none found on the client — features/cart/store.ts's setAppliedCoupon comment claims the coupon is cleared 'when items change significantly' but no code re-validates it, so a stale discountAmount stays on screen
edge_cases.risk_note: The cart shows a discount the server will refuse, and the review step falls back to client estimates with a 'You can still place the order' hint even though placing it must fail.

edge_cases.case: Coupon restricted to specific products or categories (applicable_product_ids)
edge_cases.existing_validation: no validation found — potential gap: the column is stored, exposed by the admin API and echoed back, but neither coupon_service nor order_service reads it
edge_cases.risk_note: A coupon meant for one product discounts the whole cart; a product-scoped promotion cannot be run safely.

edge_cases.case: MRP charged outside the discount window
edge_cases.existing_validation: effective_tier_price returns mrp_per_unit when the product window is inactive
edge_cases.risk_note: Needs a product whose window has closed; the storefront must then show no strikethrough and charge the MRP.

edge_cases.case: Turnaround surcharge interaction with the tier rate
edge_cases.existing_validation: compute_item_pricing adds extra_cost once per line after unit_price x quantity
edge_cases.risk_note: A surcharge folded into the per-piece rate would silently multiply by the quantity.

edge_cases.case: Rush turnaround advertised in print_specs but inactive
edge_cases.existing_validation: resolve_option / the turnaround lookup rejects an inactive option with invalid_turnaround
edge_cases.risk_note: If the PDP renders an inactive turnaround the customer can configure a line the server will refuse.

gaps: Customer phone login uses Firebase phone auth (signInWithPhoneNumber + invisible reCAPTCHA) and cannot be driven in this environment; the backend's own OTP endpoints (used by /auth/register) are the only OTP path reachable in dev. This plan signs in with email + password instead.
Coupon apply/remove lives only on /cart — the checkout review renders the applied coupon read-only, so coupon error copy can only be asserted on the cart page.

applicable_product_ids / applicable_category_ids are backend data with no enforcement anywhere; deciding what they should mean (scope the basis, or reject the cart) is a product decision, not a frontend fix.
The invoice PDF is generated by WeasyPrint on the backend (GET /orders/{id}/receipt); it has no storefront UI entry point on the confirmation page, so it can only be verified outside the browser.
